title: Multi-omics analysis reveals the role of ribosome biogenesis in malignant clear cell renal cell carcinoma and the development of a machine learning-based prognostic model.
summary: A machine-learning ribosome-biogenesis signature identified a high-risk ccRCC cell state and stratified outcomes across external cohorts.
